project_title: TonAer B2B Technology Website — Complete Light Version & Visual Refinement
target_audience: ISPs, Telecom Operators, Enterprise IT leaders, Network Service Providers, B2B Device Fleet Managers

design_philosophy.core_principle: One section = one clear message. Simple + Clean + Premium + Realistic + Engaging + Easy-to-Understand B2B Technology Website.
design_philosophy.visual_tone: Light, trustworthy, technical, authoritative, crisp, and clean. Grounded in real device hardware 3D procedural visuals, illustrative cloud dashboard UIs, and real network analytics workflows.
anti_patterns_avoided: No generic SaaS template syndrome (no repeating headline + paragraph + 3 cards + icons across every section)
No neon green / cyberpunk / dark matrix themes
No floating abstract AI brain or particle glow graphics
No empty or excessive padding/margin blank spaces
No dark-only backgrounds for core marketing sections
No fabricated customer statistics or unverified customer names
No full spec dumps on homepage

color_palette.mode: Light Dominant (with selective dark navy accents & Signal Green highlights)

usage: Primary action buttons (Explore Products, Talk to Us, Compare Now)
Selected hardware model highlights & Compare tray counter
Key tech badge accent borders and small status dots

hierarchy_rules.h1_hero: text-4xl sm:text-5xl lg:text-6xl font-bold font-display tracking-tight text-slate-900 leading-[1.1]
hierarchy_rules.h2_section: text-2xl sm:text-3xl lg:text-4xl font-bold font-display tracking-tight text-slate-900 leading-tight
hierarchy_rules.eyebrow: text-xs font-mono font-medium tracking-[0.2em] uppercase text-emerald-600 bg-emerald-50 border border-emerald-200/60 px-3 py-1 rounded-full inline-block

spacing_and_layout.section_padding: py-16 md:py-24 px-4 sm:px-6 lg:px-8 max-w-7xl mx-auto
blank_space_prevention_rules: Remove absolute positioning wrapper height assumptions
Set h-auto with responsive min-h-[400px] on 3D canvases instead of fixed 800px containers
Grid cards must stretch children with align-items: stretch
Eliminate empty placeholder divs or hidden DOM blocks consuming layout flow
